review.notes: A notice and short text messages (Pastor Anil, Sam, Kiran, Ravi sir). Times and numbers are digits. कि-clauses (रवि सर ने कहा कि ...; मैंने सुना कि ...). Pastor Anil writes आप to Sam; Kiran writes तुम to Sam as a friend. The plan's polite word "कृपया" has no reading in the word list, so the polite requests use -इए forms (भेजिए, निकालिए). The potluck dal brings back the kitchen words; Sam's report brings back the lesson and Diwali words. Adapter trap: किरण is read as a noun (a ray), not as a name, so it is used only once in a sentence. Words outside the plan (measured, adapter lemmas x tokens): किरण×1 (the adapter reads किरण as a noun, not a name). 2026-10-08: recycling paragraph(s) added by the Hindi content package so that this unit brings back the new words of earlier units (they are recall sentences, not new vocabulary).

english.source: drafted with the text; not reviewed

sentences.text: सूचना: शनिवार की बैठक शाम 5 बजे है।
sentences.english: Notice: Saturday's meeting is at 5 in the evening.

sentences.text: बैठक गिरजा के पास मैदान में होगी।
sentences.english: The meeting will be in the field near the church.
Everyone, please come.
Guests will come too.
There is a meal after the meeting.

sentences.text: खाने में दाल, रोटी और चावल होंगे।
sentences.english: There will be dal, roti and rice.

sentences.text: दाल के लिए हल्दी, नमक, मसाला, तेल और पालक चाहिए।
sentences.english: For the dal we need turmeric, salt, spice, oil and spinach.
Pots and spoons are needed too.

sentences.text: हम चूल्हा लाएँगे और दाल पकाएँगे।
sentences.english: We will bring a stove and cook the dal.

sentences.text: एक और सूचना: पहले पालक धोइए और काटिए।
sentences.english: One more notice: first wash and cut the spinach.
Then boil the water.
Please all make time.
Every Saturday we meet.
Read the notice and answer.
Hello, Sam!

sentences.text: मैं आपको यह संदेश भेजता हूँ।
sentences.english: I am sending you this message.

sentences.text: मैंने सुना कि आप हिंदी सीखना चाहते हैं।
sentences.english: I heard that you want to learn Hindi.
This is very good news.
Please do come on Saturday.
Please send your reply.
Thank you.
Hello, Pastor Anil!
I got your message.
I will certainly come on Saturday.

sentences.text: रवि सर ने कहा कि मैं हर दिन अभ्यास करूँ।
sentences.english: Ravi sir said that I should practise every day.
I have to read every day.
He teaches me the lessons.

sentences.text: आज मैंने एक नया शब्द सीखा।
sentences.english: Today I learned a new word.

sentences.text: मैं अक्षर समझता हूँ, लेकिन वाक्य में ग़लती करता हूँ।
sentences.english: I understand the letters, but I make mistakes in sentences.

sentences.text: वह मुझे बताते हैं: यह ग़लती सब करते हैं।
sentences.english: He tells me: everyone makes this mistake.

sentences.text: नानी ने बताया कि मैं दाल बना सकता हूँ।
sentences.english: Nani said that I can make dal.

sentences.text: मैं शनिवार को पालक धोऊँगा और काटूँगा।
sentences.english: On Saturday I will wash and cut the spinach.

sentences.text: नानी की ख़बर: वह ठीक हैं।
sentences.english: News of Nani: she is well.
Sam, hey! Where are you?
I have got a new job.

sentences.text: मुझे नौकरी करते एक साल हो गया है।
sentences.english: It has been a year since I started the job.

sentences.text: यह अच्छी ख़बर है, लेकिन अब मेरे पास समय नहीं है।
sentences.english: That is good news, but now I have no time.
What is your answer?
Is your job good?

sentences.text: शनिवार को मेरे मेहमान भी आएँगे।
sentences.english: My guests will come on Saturday too.

sentences.text: मैं दाल के लिए नमक और मसाला भेजता हूँ।
sentences.english: I am sending salt and spice for the dal.
You bring the turmeric and oil.
I will bring the stove and pots.
What is your phone number?
I will phone you.
Kiran, my number is: 98765 43210.

sentences.text: इस साल हम बहुत लोग हैं।
sentences.english: This year there are a lot of us.
I will stay here for a year.

sentences.text: शनिवार को बच्चे चिल्लाएँगे और खेलेंगे।
sentences.english: On Saturday the children will shout and play.

sentences.text: अमन भी चिल्लाता है, जब वह ख़ुश है।
sentences.english: Aman shouts too, when he is happy.
I don't shout.
I will make time.

sentences.text: मैं बर्तन रखूँगा और चम्मच लाऊँगा।
sentences.english: I will put the pots down and bring the spoons.
Put the stove here.
Wash your hands before eating.

sentences.text: मैं अपने हाथ से दाल बनाऊँगा।
sentences.english: I will make the dal with my own hands.
Oh, what is this?
Do not be late.
Pastor Anil, one more thing.

sentences.text: दिवाली का त्योहार बहुत अच्छा था।
sentences.english: The festival of Diwali was very good.
There was a lot of light in the lane.
Our neighbours decorate their houses.
I wished them well for the festival.
A child was sad there.

sentences.text: वह तकिया लेता है और बैठता है।
sentences.english: He takes a pillow and sits down.
Aman is his friend.
Aman plays with him.
Ring the number and tell me.
Attach the picture.
Please do come on Saturday.

sentences.text: रवि सर का संदेश भी आ गया।
sentences.english: Ravi sir's message has come too.

sentences.text: रवि सर और मीरा दीदी भी मेहमान हैं।
sentences.english: Ravi sir and Meera didi are guests too.

sentences.text: शनिवार को सभा में बहुत भीड़ है, और अचानक एक बच्चा मैदान में खो जाता है।
sentences.english: On Saturday there is a big crowd at the gathering, and suddenly a child gets lost in the field.

sentences.text: सब लोग उसे ढूँढ़ते हैं, और चाची जी पड़ोस की गली में जाती हैं।
sentences.english: Everybody looks for him, and Chachi ji goes into the neighbouring lane.

sentences.text: बच्चा यहीं बैठा है, छाया में, धीरे धीरे गाना गाता है।
sentences.english: The child is sitting right here, in the shade, singing a song slowly.

sentences.text: अरे, यह तो चाची जी का बच्चा है!
sentences.english: Oh, this is Chachi ji's child!

sentences.text: चाची जी बोलती हैं, "इसका नाम अमन नहीं, मोहन है।"
sentences.english: Chachi ji says, "His name is not Aman, it is Mohan."

sentences.text: खिड़की के पास खड़े लोग हँसते हैं, और बच्चा हँसता है।
sentences.english: The people standing near the window laugh, and the child laughs.
